sections.title: Run a night on {{brand.name}} before you run one for real.
sections.lead: Tell us about your event and we’ll set up a private demo built around it: your application questions, sample guests, and the door on the night. Nothing is published, messaged or charged.

to.message: Hi {{brand.name}}, I’d like to try a demo night.

sections.title: Four things, in about ten minutes.

items.title: Review applicants
items.body: Sample applicants answer your own questions. Approve, waitlist or decline them.

items.title: Write the replies
items.body: See the message each person would get, and change it.

items.title: Let guests in
items.body: Run the door for a sample night: who’s here, who’s late, who’s new.

items.title: Handle a request
items.body: A guest asks for help on the night. See how it reaches you.

sections.title: Not a generic tour. Your questions, your format.
sections.lead: Send us your current form or tell us what you ask guests. We set up the demo with your questions, and after you’ve tried it, we can turn it into a draft form in your own account, ready to publish.

items.question: Is the demo free?
items.answer: Yes. It’s a practice run with sample guests. Nothing is charged, published or sent.

items.question: Why can’t I open a demo straight away?
items.answer: Each demo is set up around your own event and questions. We’ll message you on WhatsApp when yours is ready.

items.question: Who can open my link?
items.answer: Only you. It opens with the phone number or email you gave us.

items.question: Can I use what I set up?
items.answer: Yes. Afterwards we can turn your demo into a draft form in your own {{brand.name}} account, ready for you to publish.

items.question: Can I just start instead?
items.answer: Of course. Start the free trial and make your first event; the demo is there if you’d like to practise first.

items.question: How long does the link last?
items.answer: You can open it up to three times before it expires.

sections.title: Start the free trial.
sections.lead: Free for 30 days from your first event, or 90 for founding hosts.
